plugins.description: Cross-OS desktop & browser control, through the accessibility tree first and screenshots last — if a human can do it on a screen, your agent can too, without being told to use it. Registers the clawdcursor MCP server (compact tool surface) and bundles its usage skill. Launches via npx, so no separate install step is required.
